title: Document Falcon-1024 Algorand account identity as protocol 1.2 without changing 0x01/0x02 envelopes
description: Document Falcon-1024 Algorand account identity as protocol 1.2 without changing 0x01/0x02 envelopes
acceptance_criteria: PROTOCOL.md, IMPLEMENTATION.md, SECURITY.md, TEST-VECTORS.md, and README.md describe Falcon-1024 as an Algorand authorizing signature for AlgoChat payments; encryption seed is 32-byte mnemonic entropy; 0x01/0x02 envelopes and existing test vectors are unchanged; Ed25519 import stays valid; Falcon minimum fee is 3x minFee; key discovery authorship is the payment signature; bun scripts/validate.ts passes.
